RE-ELECT DREW COMBS
# Proven Leadership.
Real Results.
Keeping Menlo Park safe, protecting our neighborhoods, and delivering practical solutions for every resident.
## Why Re-Elect Drew?
Building on a proven record of results while protecting the neighborhoods, parks, and quality of life that make Menlo Park one of the best places to call home.
### □ Public Safety
Support first responders, improve emergency preparedness, and keep our neighborhoods safe for every family.
### □ Parks & Open Space
Continue investing in parks, playgrounds, recreational facilities, and open spaces that bring our community together.
### □ Responsible Growth
Plan thoughtfully for the future while protecting neighborhood character and the quality of life residents value.
### □ Safe Streets
Improve traffic safety, pedestrian access, bicycle infrastructure, and neighborhood connectivity.
### □ Fiscal Responsibility
Protect taxpayer dollars through transparent budgeting and responsible long-term financial planning.
### □ Accessible Leadership
Remain accessible through community office hours, neighborhood meetings, and a monthly newsletter explaining my position on city issues.
## ☕ Meet Drew at Community Office Hours
One of the best ideas starts with a conversation. Drew believes the best decisions come from listening to residents. That's why he regularly hosts Community Office Hours, giving everyone an opportunity to ask questions, share concerns, and discuss ideas for improving Menlo Park.
□
### When
Every Saturday
9:00 AM - 10:00 AM
□
### Where
Café Zoe
1929 Menalto Avenue
Menlo Park
✉️
### Contact
[email protected]
No appointment is necessary.
Stop by, say hello, and let's talk about the future of Menlo Park.
